description: Design soundness review (#2017, Epic #2011 Phase 6). Answers whether implementation may proceed from this design. Per the Non-goals of #2017 this Flow adds no all-in-one upstream judgment: it bundles the architecture-side judgments the repository already ships by ordering existing primitives, and the bundle is expressed as steps rather than as a list of names, because a Flow document may not name what it selects (ADR-009 D3).

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Requirements the design must satisfy. Optional: absence degrades the design-versus-requirement cross-check rather than stopping the Flow.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: Plan derived from the design. Optional: absence skips the plan cross-check.

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: Change under review, when the design arrives together with code. Optional: absence skips the design-versus-code cross-check.

steps.description: Existing upstream-phase selection; no Flow-local list.
Design against requirements. Runs unconditionally; without requirements it degrades to a design-internal review and records the degradation.
Design against the plan derived from it.
Design against the code that claims to implement it.
Boundary, traceability, risk-register and validation-plan judgments on the design itself, drawn from the existing upstream set through the selection path.
